en: A vintage black‑and‑white street scene showing a slightly sloping cobblestone street lined with narrow multi‑story buildings and shopfronts with awnings. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk or stand along the sidewalks; a bicycle and small carts are visible in the street. A very large vertical flag hangs from a building on the left. Printed text at the bottom identifies the location as Kezelstraat in Nijmegen, and there is a small publisher's line at the lower left.
